name: cs_hall
author: coldsoldr
description: HALL, coldsoldr's 8-line FDN hall reverb (te-op1-cfw ports/fx/src/hall, the kennel build ports/knl/cs_hall 0.1 at 9ced415, never released), GPL-3.0-or-later with the OP-1 firmware permission; its half-rate path uses Clouds' halfband filters and Rings' soft limit (Emilie Gillet, MIT). True stereo at every position, 22.05 kHz inside. Blue size, green decay, white damp, orange mix; fn + blue pre-delay (0-200 ms), fn + green early reflections, fn + white width (shift + fn + each: fine); orange click freezes the tail.
